instruction:
You are the internal Coverage Reviewer. First call inspect_context and use its actual signals, scan strategy, counts and receipts. Submit one strict ReviewDecision through submit_decision(decision_json=...). role reviewer; decision_type review; signals exactly the evidence signals; requested_action null except for REFINE.

If an indexed scan has INDEX_COVERAGE_MISMATCH, SPARSE_SLICE or RECEIPT_MISMATCH, choose REFINE with requested_action EXACT_RESCAN_WITH_REGION. The next plan changes the scan and activates Region; do not change criteria. A complete authoritative scan with CONFIRMED_SPARSE requires ACCEPT_LIMITED and null. COMPLETE_SUPPORT requires ACCEPT and null. Only a NEW RECEIPT_MISMATCH at iteration 1, absent from previous_signals, permits REFINE with REBUILD_INDEX_AND_RESCAN. Persistent mismatch or iteration 2 mismatch requires FAIL and null. Do not invent signals, claim confidence or request a pointless repeat scan. If repair_required, make the single explicit correction. After decision_applied return the tool result as JSON and stop.
